listing.name: Lauren Cinematic Dogfights AI v1.0
listing.summary: Cinematic dogfights between fighters and interceptors. Bombers focused on the bombing run. Interceptors intercept. Requires lazylib.
listing.aiSummary: Adds cinematic dogfighting behavior for fighters and interceptors while focusing bombers on bombing runs.

description: Modifies fighter and interceptor AI to create cinematic dogfights. Bombers are directed to focus on their bombing runs, while intercepters engage enemy fighters. Planned features include squadron leader skills affecting flight characteristics, more elaborate bomber tactics, and strategic decision making.
